notes.author: Daniel Park, MD
notes.text:
Subjective
Pain improved this morning. Tolerating oral intake. No nausea or vomiting.

Objective
Afebrile. Abdomen soft, nondistended. Incisions clean and dry.

Assessment & Plan
Postoperative day 1 after laparoscopic appendectomy. Advance diet, ambulate, continue multimodal analgesia. Review discharge readiness this afternoon.
